photos.desc: Poor man's tablet macro. Juvenile female specimen hidden in duckweed. Do you see it?
Courtship of Sminthurides aquaticus from England.
I like the way the female S. aquaticus is lumbering away into the distance while the male pauses to look around. Click on the photo. It really does look better in black!

Sad. These were victims of surface tension, too small to escape from each other. Some had already died when I saw them. Needless to say. I separated them after the photo! Next to them is a flatworm- D
